ascension.heading: ASCENSION
ascension.intro: You have carried a soul to the empty Throne and back. Set how hard the dark presses on the next walk down.
ascension.label: ▲ Ascension
ascension.noModifiers: No modifiers — the chain as the world first knew it.

intro.s0: In the dark, you wake. Iron at your wrists. Salt on your tongue. The stink of the dying nearby.
intro.s1: You remember a forest road. A blade between your ribs. Your sister's voice, calling.
intro.s2: You remember the man with the eyes that did not blink — the one who said, "You are mine now."
intro.s3: Slainkin. Childe of the slain. You have proven exceptionally resilient. Even your sister's screams could not break you. Yet.
intro.s4: The cell door is not locked. He has left it open for you to walk.
intro.s5: You will work for me, whether you know it or not. The cellars beneath this place are mine — and so, in time, will be the rest. Walk, child. There is so much you have to learn.
intro.s6: He gave no name. The unblinking eyes did not need one.
